prompt.alinti: Someone in Anthropic built the most useful Claude skill I've ever seen, and you probably haven't switched it on yet. It's a skill that builds skills for you. You describe how your team does a job, say like onboarding a new client step-by-step, you do it in plain English. It asks you a few questions, then it writes up a Claude skill, which Claude will follow the same way every single time, no matter who on your team is actually running it. And the crazy part is that it's already sitting in your Claude settings. The only catch is it can only write down what you can explain.
